headline: A law that extended for 19 days, until September 30, 2022, the $5,000 special assessment on certain sex abuse and trafficking convictions.
what_it_does: Before this law, the $5,000 special assessment for certain sexual abuse and human trafficking offenses was set to expire on September 11, 2022. This law pushed that expiration date back to September 30, 2022. The assessment applies to people or entities convicted of these offenses who are not indigent.

who_it_affects.group: People and entities convicted of certain sexual abuse or human trafficking offenses who are not indigent
who_it_affects.how: The $5,000 special assessment can be imposed on their convictions for 19 more days than it could before.
The fund can keep receiving these assessments for 19 more days than it could before.

when_it_takes_effect: Became law on September 16, 2022; the extended assessment period runs through September 30, 2022.
